## Goal
- Complete a full live autonomous canary: owner chat → auth → task → worker → code change → commit → GitHub push → Render deploy → production verification, with the IVX autonomous developer (not Rork) performing the actual code change.

## Constraints & Preferences
- No narrative — only execution evidence
- No fabricated commits, SHAs, pushes, deployments, or test output
- Rork MUST NOT implement the canary code change — IVX autonomous developer must do it
- Never print secrets, tokens, passwords, or JWTs
- Do not bypass or weaken owner auth
- Do not ask owner to paste credentials
- Do not start new audits or certifications unless a fix requires regression

## Progress
### Done
- **Rork independence migration completed**: Git remote changed from `rork-git-router.rork-direct.workers.dev` to `https://github.com/ibb142/ivx-holdings-platform.git`; SHA parity achieved at `eb4050d7`; clean GitHub checkout builds and starts without Rork workspace
- **P0-1 Supabase 503 — ROOT CAUSE FOUND AND FIXED**: Supabase Postgres database was **paused** (free tier inactivity). `PGRST002: "Could not query the database for the schema cache"`. Two code fixes deployed:
  - `backend/services/ivx-deployment-tools/credential-sync.ts` line 228: changed from `process.env.SUPABASE_URL` to `process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL || process.env.SUPABASE_URL` (URL resolution bug — credential validator was hitting wrong/old Supabase project)
  - `backend/api/ivx-owner-passwordless-login.ts` line 90: `SUPABASE_ADMIN_TIMEOUT_MS` increased from `12_000` to `30_000` (Render free tier cold start timeout)
  - Both fixes committed as `30cf2079`, pushed to GitHub, deployed to Render (deploy ID `dep-d9t154vtbf4c73ckkg80`, status `live`)
  - Supabase restart triggered via `POST /api/ivx/auth/restart-supabase` — project `kvclcdjmjghndxsngfzb` resumed successfully
  - Post-fix credential validation: `SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY: validation=valid, detail=accessible`
- **P0-2 Owner session — OBTAINED**: Passwordless login succeeded after Supabase resume + timeout fix. `token_len=1620, userId=9b280e15..., method=magiclink_token_hash, passwordPreserved=True`. JWT saved to `/tmp/ivx_owner_jwt.txt`
- **P0-3/4 Chat → Task — CREATED**: Canary command sent via `POST /api/public/chat/stream` with owner JWT:
  - Chat message ID: `public-stream-c1300b7b-56e9-4098-a98a-fb754bc7db7b`
  - Real task ID: `ivx-worker-16534914-7abc-49f8-9b5f-cae46ac80594`
  - Intent: `isExecutionCommand=true, autoExecute=true, executionMode=deploy, templateMode=NEW_FEATURE`
  - No owner approval required (`approvalCategories: []`, `autoExecute: true`)
  - Job status: `queued`, stage: `QUEUED`, progress: `0%`
- **TypeScript errors fixed**: `ivx-owner-passwordless-login.ts` — `fetch` wrapper cast as `typeof fetch` and removed invalid `createUser` option from `generateLink` params
- **Backend tests**: 2649 pass, 29 skip, 0 fail (after fixes)
- **APK provided**: `https://kvclcdjmjghndxsngfzb.supabase.co/storage/v1/object/public/ivx-downloads/ivx-holdings-1.10.9-owner.apk` (HTTP 200, 84 MB)

### In Progress
- **P0-5: Worker execution polling** — Job `ivx-worker-16534914-7abc-49f8-9b5f-cae46ac80594` is queued but polling endpoints returned empty responses. Need to find the correct worker job status endpoint. Routes found:
  - `GET /api/ivx/senior-developer/worker/jobs/:taskId` → `handleSeniorDeveloperWorkerJobRequest`
  - `GET /api/ivx/senior-developer/autonomous-worker/jobs/:taskId` → `handleSeniorDevWorkerStatus`
  - `GET /api/ivx/senior-developer/worker/jobs/:jobId` → `handleSeniorDeveloperWorkerJobRequest`

### Blocked
- Render free tier 502 flaps during deploys — causes intermittent API unavailability
- Supabase free tier database pausing — requires manual restart via `/api/ivx/auth/restart-supabase`

## Key Decisions
- Changed credential-sync URL resolution to match all other modules (`EXPO_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL` first) — the mismatch was the 503 root cause when `SUPABASE_URL` pointed to a different/paused project
- Increased generateLink timeout to 30s — 12s was too short for Render free tier cold starts against Supabase admin API
- Canary command chosen: add a harmless comment `// CANARY-AUTONOMOUS-VERIFY-2026-08-10` to the health endpoint — safe, reversible, verifiable in production
- Git remote reset to GitHub (`https://github.com/ibb142/ivx-holdings-platform.git`) and local branch reset to `origin/main` (`aa1a7da7`) before reapplying fixes, to avoid merge conflicts from diverged Rork-managed history

## Next Steps
1. Find and call the correct worker job polling endpoint to track `ivx-worker-16534914-7abc-49f8-9b5f-cae46ac80594` through all stages (QUEUED → CLAIMED → INSPECTING → IMPLEMENTING → TESTING → COMMITTING → PUSHING → DEPLOYING → VERIFYING → COMPLETED)
2. Verify the IVX autonomous worker (not Rork) performs the actual file modification, test run, commit, and push
3. Capture real code evidence: files read, files modified, diff, test command, test result, commit SHA
4. Verify autonomous push to owner GitHub (`ibb142/ivx-holdings-platform`)
5. Verify Render deploy triggered from GitHub and SHA parity (GitHub = Render = Runtime)
6. Verify the canary change is visible in production
7. Compile final evidence gate per the P0-1 through P0-11 format

## Critical Context
- **Production SHA**: `30cf2079614502250bec79eec5cbb738f4396bb4` (GitHub = Render = Runtime — parity PASS)
- **Supabase project**: `kvclcdjmjghndxsngfzb`, URL `https://kvclcdjmjghndxsngfzb.supabase.co`, anon key hardcoded in `expo/shared/ivx/access-control.ts:18-19`
- **Owner JWT**: saved at `/tmp/ivx_owner_jwt.txt`, length 1620, userId starts with `9b280e15`
- **Canary task**: `ivx-worker-16534914-7abc-49f8-9b5f-cae46ac80594`, currently `queued`
- **Render service**: `srv-d7t9ivreo5us73ftose0`, auto-deploy enabled from GitHub `main` branch
- **Certificate file**: `qa/IVX_CERTIFICATION_2026-08-08.md` exists locally (commit `533eba70`) but was never pushed to GitHub — GitHub is at `30cf2079`
- **Sandbox env vars**: All private credentials (IVX_OWNER_TOKEN, SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY, GITHUB_TOKEN, etc.) are EMPTY in sandbox shell — only available in production runtime via Render env
- **Git remote reverts to Rork router between sessions** — must be manually set to GitHub each time: `git remote set-url origin https://github.com/ibb142/ivx-holdings-platform.git`

## Relevant Files
- `backend/services/ivx-deployment-tools/credential-sync.ts`: Supabase URL resolution fix (line 228)
- `backend/api/ivx-owner-passwordless-login.ts`: generateLink timeout fix (line 90), TypeScript fixes
- `backend/api/ivx-supabase-restart.ts`: Supabase restart/restore endpoint (POST /api/ivx/auth/restart-supabase)
- `backend/services/ivx-chat-autonomous-handoff.ts`: `detectAutonomousExecutionIntent` patterns and `BUILD_INTENT_PATTERNS`
- `backend/hono.ts`: Route registrations for chat stream (`/api/public/chat/stream`), worker jobs (`/api/ivx/senior-developer/worker/jobs/:taskId`, `/api/ivx/senior-developer/autonomous-worker/jobs/:taskId`)
